summary: Design governed lakehouse, streaming, and warehouse platforms with practical migration and FinOps skills. Explore the course and enrol today.
lede: Cloud data platform training helps architects, engineers, and platform owners design governed systems for analytics, reporting, and controlled data sharing. It addresses the practical task of connecting storage, processing, governance, and operational decisions in a coherent platform model. Participants practise selecting lakehouse, warehouse, and streaming patterns, setting access and lineage controls, and developing migration plans with cost measures.
audienceIntro: This course suits professionals who design, run, govern, procure, or oversee enterprise data platforms and need a common architectural language across technology, risk, and business teams.
modules: Modern Data Platforms and Architecture Drivers
Platform Operating Model and Executive Reporting
prerequisites: You should have working exposure to enterprise data environments, databases, cloud services, analytics platforms, or IT architecture. Familiarity with SQL, data pipelines, and basic information-security concepts will help, but coding is not required for completion. The course uses architecture diagrams, configuration examples, digital templates, and scenario-based analysis rather than production deployment. Advanced topics such as Apache Kafka operations, Terraform automation, Data Mesh, and FinOps are taught at conceptual and operational application level, not technical engineering or enterprise implementation depth.
topics: Statistics & data analysis (SPSS, Stata, R, Python)
